question: On single substitutions of the AMFR 47-residue construct, does ESM-2 8M masked-marginal scoring rank proteolysis-inferred folding stability better than the EVCouplings site-independent model, and which variants account for the difference?

task.target: DMS_score as supplied by ProteinGym; higher is more stable; no sign change
task.endpoint_scope: cDNA display proteolysis folding stability of a 47-residue construct; not AMFR cellular function or organismal fitness
task.split: none; zero-shot scoring of all variants; no method is fitted to assay labels

methods.name: ESM-2 8M masked marginals
methods.score: sum over substituted sites of log P(mutant) - log P(wild type) at the masked site in wild-type context
methods.inputs: id, assay_id, wild-type sequence, mutant and mutated sequence; the score uses the wild-type sequence and substitutions; the adapter rejects any other field, so labels cannot reach it
methods.training_overlap: unknown; pretrained on UniRef50 2021_04 (UR50/D); the target sequence or homologues may be present; membership not checked

methods.name: EVCouplings site-independent model
methods.score: sum over substituted sites of h*_i(mutant) - h*_i(wild type); h* refitted by BFGS to the model's stored single-site frequencies, N_eff and lambda_h with couplings zero
methods.inputs: wild-type sequence, substitutions and one reviewed plmc_v2 model
methods.adaptation: label-free parameter estimation on a homologous-sequence alignment; no assay labels
methods.training_overlap: family-specific: the alignment contains the target family by construction; assay labels not used
methods.status: implemented and validated on synthetic models; blocked by G3

methods.name: EVmutation full (epistatic) model
methods.score: delta statistical energy E(mutant) - E(wild type) of the full Potts model using its fitted fields and couplings
methods.inputs: same plmc_v2 model file as M2
methods.relation_to_M2: M2 refits fields without couplings; M3 uses jointly fitted fields and couplings. The contrast changes fields and couplings together and does not isolate coupling terms or show epistasis.

null_reference.name: seeded-random-v1
null_reference.role: supplementary null; not one of the three methods; one fixed ranking, not a chance distribution; no bootstrap contrast

evolutionary_model.route: chosen at G0 and fixed before the model is obtained; if it fails the pilot stops; a route change needs a new reviewed protocol decision before any prediction

route_a.status: no request sent; outreach is the human decision owner's decision

required.training_alignment: actual alignment bytes used for training, supplied and hashed; if different from the pinned v1.3 alignment, rejected unless a reviewed spec amendment adopts it before any prediction; the v1.3 hash is never recorded as its provenance
required.query_and_index_audit: alignment query ID, region and focus columns agree with the model target and index list; index list maps onto the wild type
required.generation_configuration: source-authored configuration or command covering method and version, filtering, weighting and regularisation
required.source_link: attributable source record (archived manifest or log, or supplier record naming model and input hashes) tying the alignment and configuration to the model file
required.consistency_review: header, coordinates and stored statistics consistent with the configuration and alignment

desirable.fit_termination: historical termination log; if unavailable recorded as unknown and M3 results make no convergence claim

not_required: reproducing the original alignment search or retraining
route_a.record: supplier, date, terms of use and sharing

route_b.description: Rewire plmc fit on the ProteinGym v1.3 AMFR alignment
route_b.build: make all-mac, unmodified (clang, double-precision arithmetic, no OpenMP); only permitted deviation is removing -msse4.2 if the build fails on arm64, recorded with the binary SHA256
route_b.output_precision: float32 (plmc OUTPUT_PRECISION, independent of build precision)
route_b.command: plmc -c AMFR_HUMAN.ec -o AMFR_HUMAN.model -f AMFR_HUMAN -g -m 100 -t 0.2 -lh 0.01 -le 7.6 AMFR_HUMAN_2023-08-07_b04.a2m 2> plmc.stderr
route_b.alphabet: plmc built-in default; no -a flag, because focus-column removal depends on the built-in alphabet

derivation.theta: EVCouplings theta 0.8 passed to plmc as 1 - theta = 0.2
derivation.lambda_J: 0.01 * (q - 1) * (L - 1); q = 20 with gaps ignored; L = 41 uppercase query positions; 7.6
derivation.focus: query ID with region suffix removed, as EVCouplings passes it
derivation.basis: EVCouplings e1362407 config/sample_config_monomer.txt, couplings/protocol.py and couplings/tools.py

route_b.historical_match: not known to match ProteinGym's historical EVmutation run

fit_acceptance.evidence: the 'Gradient optimization:' line in plmc.stderr; the model header records requested, not performed, iterations
fit_acceptance.MAXIMUMITERATION: accept; label 'fixed-budget fit, 100 iterations (EVCouplings default), not converged' on every M3 result

provenance_review_receipt.freeze: model, alignment, configuration and prepared-artifact hashes frozen in the spec before any prediction
provenance_review_receipt.claim_limit: neither route supports a claim to reproduce ProteinGym's historical rows
provenance_review_receipt.stop_if: any required item cannot be established

populations.P1_primary: single substitutions whose position and residues are covered by the M2/M3 model index list and alphabet; frozen at G5 from the model and mutant strings only
populations.P2_doubles: double substitutions with both sites covered; descriptive only
populations.P0_full: all 2972 variants with per-method coverage and unscored reasons
populations.freeze_before: any prediction on AMFR data, including real-model parity

expected_P1_from_alignment.basis: uppercase (focus) columns of AMFR_HUMAN_2023-08-07_b04.a2m; lowercase positions 1-5 and 47
expected_P1_from_alignment.authority: expectation only; the reviewed model index list at G5 is authoritative

populations.rule: every comparison uses exactly the frozen P1 or P2 ID list for every method; a method that fails to score any frozen ID stops the analysis

primary_analysis.estimand: delta_rho = Spearman(M1 score, DMS_score) - Spearman(M2 score, DMS_score) on P1
primary_analysis.weighting: each variant weighted equally within the Spearman calculation
primary_analysis.undefined: null with reason if M1, M2 or the label is constant on P1; M3 and N0 do not affect validity

bootstrap.positions: distinct P1 positions as integers, ascending; variants within a position ordered by variant ID
bootstrap.draw: rng.integers(0, K, size=K); resample is the drawn positions' variants in draw order, repeated per draw
bootstrap.ranks: recomputed on each resample, average ranks for ties including duplicates
bootstrap.shared_draws: the same 10000 draws serve the primary and both secondary contrasts
bootstrap.invalid: a draw is invalid for a contrast if any of that contrast's methods or the label is constant in the resample
bootstrap.report: attempted and valid draw counts per contrast
bootstrap.interpretation: conditional on this assay, under approximate exchangeability of positions; not a population or suite-level confidence interval

primary_analysis.sensitivity: leave-one-position-out delta_rho for every P1 position, reported in position order
primary_analysis.minimum_practical_difference_basis: planning decision for this pilot; not a universal or biological threshold

outcome_classes.not_classified: delta_rho undefined, or interval not computed (inadequate P1) or refused
outcome_classes.inconclusive: any other defined delta_rho with a computed interval
outcome_classes.disjoint: the point-estimate conditions of the three substantive classes do not overlap

primary_analysis.claim_limit: comparative ranking on one assay; not incremental predictive information and not a statement about protein language models in general

secondary_analyses.interval: numpy.quantile(valid_values, [0.0125, 0.9875], method='linear'); Bonferroni over S1 and S2
secondary_analyses.rules: same draws, validity, refusal and adequacy rules as the primary
secondary_analyses.interpretation_limit: S1 compares a full Potts model with a site-independent refit from the same statistics; it does not isolate couplings or show epistasis

descriptive_analyses.D1: five ProteinGym metrics (Spearman, AUC, MCC, NDCG, top-10% recall) for M1, M2, M3 and N0 on P1, using the supplied DMS_score_bin (full-assay median cutoff); undefined metrics null
descriptive_analyses.D2: P0 coverage and unscored reasons per method; SDK partial-status metrics on original denominators

D3.scope: Spearman per method over all of P2 and within each of the 7 site pairs
D3.pair_rule: report a pair's value only if it has at least 30 covered doubles and neither the method nor the label is constant within it; otherwise count and reason
D3.limit: pairs share sites; values are not independent and are not combined into any test
D3.comparison: descriptive comparison of whole models (full Potts, site-independent refit, M1, N0) on doubles; no attribution to couplings or epistasis

D4.d: abs(q_M2 - q_label) - abs(q_M1 - q_label); positive means M1 closer
D4.position_summary: mean d and variant count for every P1 position in position order, whatever the count
D4.listed_variants: up to 10 with d > 0 (largest first) and up to 10 with d < 0 (most negative first); fewer if fewer exist; d = 0 not listed; ties by variant ID
D4.limit: display of disagreement, not a decomposition of delta_rho

descriptive_analyses.D5: M1 and N0 Spearman on uncovered singles, only if at least 30 variants across at least 5 positions and method and label non-constant

subgroup_rule: no subgroup metric, bin or example selection beyond D1-D5 as defined
prohibited: changing assay, population, metric, threshold or method after predictions are compared with labels
subgroup bins chosen after inspecting labels or predictions
substituting an MSA-frequency, BLOSUM or other ad hoc score under the M2 or M3 identity
refitting plmc with other settings after the fit status is known
combining methods with assay labels (supervised stacking) in this pilot

host.cpu: Apple M4, 10 logical CPUs (4 performance, 6 efficiency)

resources.storage: all environments, caches, inputs and outputs on the external SSD

m1_execution.existing_measurement: 0.1878 s SDK inference timer, 2972 variants, 2026-09-20; excludes loading, preparation and metrics; not end-to-end
m1_execution.cache: masked-position log-probabilities cached per (sequence, position) for the life of the adapter; one forward pass per distinct substituted position (47 for AMFR)

measurements.section_timing: for in-process Python sections, the harness records wall (time.perf_counter) and CPU (time.process_time) at the start and end of each section
measurements.process_totals: /usr/bin/time -l per process: whole-process wall, CPU and peak RSS
measurements.memory_label: peak RSS is reported for the named process (for example load plus scoring), never as inference-only or per-section memory
sections: model preparation (plmc build and fit, or retrieval)
cold load per method (M1, M2, M3, N0), three fresh processes each, construction only
warm scoring per method, five repeats over all 2972 variants, starting after loading

warm_scoring_policies.M1: per record, one masked-marginal lookup per substitution; model forward batch 1 only for uncached positions; cache emptied by the harness before each repeat; forward-pass count reported; optional labelled cache-lookup-only pass
warm_scoring_policies.M2: per record, parse substitutions and sum prepared field differences; fields read at construction; no per-call cache
warm_scoring_policies.M3: per record, statistical-energy difference from the loaded model; cache behaviour recorded from the frozen G4 adapter; if it caches, emptied before each repeat
warm_scoring_policies.N0: per record, one SHA256 of the seeded ID; no model or cache

measurements.external_command_cpu: time.process_time excludes child processes; CPU for environment builds, the compiler and plmc comes from each command's own /usr/bin/time -l totals

resources.monetary_cost: not estimated; no incremental cloud charge

artifact_replay.sharing: Route B: private sharing by Rewire; public redistribution a separate decision. Route A: per supplier terms; if sharing is forbidden and the file cannot be obtained from the supplier, replay is recorded as not possible
artifact_replay.target_status: declared planning targets, not demonstrated cross-platform guarantees; not changed after results
artifact_replay.undefined_or_refused: agreement if both runs are undefined or refused for the same reason; otherwise a discrepancy
artifact_replay.discrepancy: investigated and recorded beside the original; the original is not overwritten; not in itself a refutation; neither rerun results nor discrepancies are published automatically; they go through the same publication review, which issue 40 does not authorise

external_rerun.regeneration: Route B only: rebuild plmc and refit with the fixed command; compared as a separate result, not expected to be bit-identical
